item.title: Mexican authorities say no formal FBI request in Guthrie case
item.description: The attorney general of the Mexican state of Sonora clarified Wednesday that his office has not received a formal request from the FBI to collaborate in the search for 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie.

item.title: Large banner featuring Trump's face hung on Department of Justice
item.description: A large banner featuring Donald Trump's face was hung on the exterior of Justice Department headquarters on Thursday in a physical display of the Republican president's efforts to exert power over the law enforcement agency that once investigated him.

item.title: These states don't require an ID to vote at the polls. The 'SAVE Act' could change that
item.description: Months ahead of the midterm elections, Congress could pass legislation that would enact new, strict identification requirements that could impact how you vote.

item.title: 'Heartbroken': California avalanche victims' families release statement
item.description: The families of six women who died in a fatal avalanche that claimed the lives of nine people are asking for "privacy and space" as they grieve the tragedy.

item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan ("McSteamy") on ABC's "Grey's Anatomy" has died at the age of 53.
